## Problem

Forecast daily sales for 1,115 Rossmann stores 42 days ahead.

## Approach

Comparison between classical statistical models fitted per store and a single global machine learning model trained on all stores.

## Technologies

[Python]{.tag} [pandas]{.tag} [Time series]{.tag} [Machine Learning]{.tag} [Walk-forward validation]{.tag} [Optuna]{.tag} [SHAP]{.tag} [Streamlit]{.tag}

## Results

A single global model (LightGBM) reached **RMSPE 0.1321** and **MAPE 9.7%** on the test set, beating the specialized SARIMAX in 3 of the 4 series compared. The project also documents where the classical model still wins: the 17 stores with atypical behavior.
